articles.headline: Dozens of ships head through Strait of Hormuz after US-Iran deal
articles.summary: Traffic in the waterway has risen since the US and Iran signed a deal aimed at ending the war, including 42 ships on Saturday alone.
articles._summary: At least 172 vessels have crossed through the Strait of Hormuz since the US and Iran signed a deal aimed at ending the war, including 42 ships on Saturday alone, according to new data from maritime intelligence firm Kpler. The number of vessels making the transit from 18 June, the day after the deal was signed, is still well below the pre-conflict average of some 138 crossings each day. Ship-tracking data analysed by BBC Verify shows more than 200 tankers appear to be waiting inside the strait on Tuesday, with at least 10 ships moving west into the Gulf so far. The price of a barrel of Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, has dropped to its lowest level since the war began. Many of the tankers that have transited the strait in recent days have been linked with Iran following the lifting of the US naval blockade as part of the deal.
articles._zh_headline: 美伊达成协议后数十艘船只驶过霍尔木兹海峡
articles._zh_summary: 海事情报公司 Kpler 的最新数据显示，自美国和伊朗签署旨在结束战争的协议以来，至少有 172 艘船只穿越霍尔木兹海峡，其中仅周六就有 42 艘船只穿越霍尔木兹海峡。从 6 月 18 日（协议签署后的第二天）起过境的船只数量仍远低于冲突前每天约 138 艘的平均水平。 BBC verify 分析的船舶跟踪数据显示，周二似乎有 200 多艘油轮在海峡内等待，到目前为止，至少有 10 艘船向西驶入海湾。全球石油基准布伦特原油的每桶价格已跌至战争开始以来的最低水平。作为协议的一部分，美国解除海上封锁后，最近几天通过该海峡的许多油轮都与伊朗有联系。

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: Tech Stocks Aren’t In A 2000-Style Bubble, This Chart Suggests
articles.summary: Ed Yardeni says today's rally — Nasdaq 100 trading 18% above its 200-day moving averag — is driven by earnings growth, not speculation.
articles._summary: The Nasdaq 100 is back near record territory, trading around 30,350, and it sits roughly 18% above its 200-day moving average. That looks stretched until you set it against the last time anyone called technology stocks a bubble. At the peak of the dot-com mania in early 2000, the index ran nearly 60% above the same trend line. Today’s premium is barely a third of that. The distance between price and the 200-day moving average is one of the bluntest measures of how far a market has sprinted ahead of its own trend.

"There’s no chance I would support the Republican Party," Carlson expressed, signaling a growing rift within the conservative community as debates over the Iran war and U.S.-Israel policy heat up. "I’m out,” he added. Carlson clarified that he is not supporting the Democratic Party either. “I don’t know what I’m going to do.” Carlson criticized the GOP for endorsing President Donald Trump ‘s Iran war under the sway of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu . He referred to this conflict, which he believes the U.S. has “effectively lost already”, as the ultimate proof of the party’s desertion of its citizens.

articles.headline: Did you know? Alan Greenspan and Ayn Rand were close friends
articles.summary: One of the most intellectually important relationships in the life of the late Fed chair Alan Greenspan was with his close friend, the formidable novelist and libertarian thinker Ayn Rand.
articles._summary: Alan Greenspan and Ayn Rand are pictured in the Oval Office on Sept. 4, 1974, after Greenspan's swearing in as Chairman of the Council of Economic Advisors. David Hume Kennerly/Getty Images/Hulton Archive hide caption One of the most important intellectual relationships in the life of Alan Greenspan, the prominent former central banker who died Monday , was with author Ayn Rand, whose 1957 novel Atlas Shrugged has become a perennial favorite among conservatives and which the Library of Congress named as one of the books that has shaped America . The two first met when he was in his mid-twenties and she was in her forties, and already well-established via her 1943 novel The Fountainhead , which had been a best-seller. They were introduced through Greenspan's then-wife, the Canadian art historian Joan Mitchell. Mitchell was a close friend of the wife of Nathaniel Branden. Branden was Rand's protege and longtime lover.
articles._zh_headline: 你可知道？艾伦·格林斯潘和艾因·兰德是亲密的朋友
articles._zh_summary: 1974 年 9 月 4 日，格林斯潘宣誓就任经济顾问委员会主席后，艾伦·格林斯潘和艾因·兰德在椭圆形办公室合影。大卫·休姆·肯纳利/盖蒂图片社/赫尔顿档案馆隐藏说明周一去世的著名前央行行长艾伦·格林斯潘一生中最重要的知识分子关系之一是与作家艾因·兰德的关系。他 1957 年的小说《阿特拉斯耸耸肩》一直受到保守派人士的喜爱，美国国会图书馆将其列为塑造美国的书籍之一。两人第一次相识时，他二十多岁，而她四十多岁，并通过她 1943 年的畅销书《源泉》而确立了地位。他们是通过格林斯潘当时的妻子、加拿大艺术史学家琼·米切尔介绍的。米切尔是纳撒尼尔·布兰登妻子的密友。布兰登是兰德的门生和长期的情人。

articles.headline: GOOGL, MSFT Plunge Up To 6% On Monday: What Is Going On With AI Hyperscalers?
articles.summary: AI CapEx fears have Big Tech sliding, but David Katz is using the selloff to buy more. Find out why he's bullish on hyperscalers and cautious on chips.
articles._summary: The market is souring on the AI hyperscalers’ massive capex, but Matrix Asset Advisors’ David Katz is using the drop to buy more. Katz, chief investment officer at Matrix Asset Advisors, told CNBC he is not selling. He sees a buying opportunity. The pullback has left the group trading at 18 to 22 times earnings, which Katz called attractive for dominant franchises with strong long-term growth prospects.
articles._zh_headline: GOOGL、MSFT 周一暴跌 6%：AI 超大规模企业发生了什么？
articles._zh_summary: 市场对人工智能超大规模企业的巨额资本支出感到不满，但 Matrix Asset Advisors 的 David Katz 正在利用这一下降来购买更多资产。 Matrix Asset Advisors 首席投资官卡茨告诉 CNBC，他不会出售该资产。他看到了买入机会。这次回调使该集团的市盈率达到了 18 至 22 倍，卡茨称这对于具有强劲长期增长前景的主导特许经营商具有吸引力。
